statement: For the actual negative basis X1,...,X7 and positive basis Yi=B_+(Xi) under the explicit F23 based isomorphism, let rho be a continuous representation in Aff1(k), for any finite field k. Put C=chi(R_sign), k1=F_p(C), k0=F_p(chi(V_sign)) and r=chi(Y1). On the exact locus product_i chi(Yi)=1 and k0=k1(r), the images rho(mathcal K_sign) and rho(R_sign) are equal. This includes all characteristics, scalar-field extension degrees and larger original coefficient fields. On C nontrivial, the summed continuous H1 restriction of the m distinct k1-Frobenius conjugate characters is injective, and its cocycle kernel consists exactly of principal tuples with parameter sum zero, of dimension m-1 and rank 6m+1 on 7m coordinates.
depends_on: F21 actual normal generation; F22 actual marginal surjections and deleted-generator normal generation; F23 original eleven source automorphisms and based sign isomorphism; F24 individual continuous H1 restriction injection and audited universal Laurent source matrices; F25 equal scalar-field affine images; F26 exact scalar-preserving trace reduction. The word verifier uses the frozen integral Laurent arithmetic previously reviewed with F29.
manuscript_passages: Part F root-adjoining intersection question; Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; original F7/F19 residual subgroup-membership reduction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Every subgroup inclusion, original source word, retained X1 principal pivot, coefficient map and based sign comparison is explicit.
computational_checks: A separate producer transports the three frozen universal source matrices under the exact six-variable product-one exponent map. The independent verifier imports no producer or algebra package; it reconstructs original sources 0, 2 and 7, with braid lengths 122, 56 and 170, by exact integer Laurent affine arithmetic. Its 45 checks compare all seven-dimensional action entries, both inverse bases, the boundary kernel and coefficient section, all principal-vector identities, the displayed denominator-cleared source-0 scalar action on the five-dimensional invariant subspace, and boundary characters 1, rt and t^-1. Root fully read the proof and both programs, reported mathematical PASS, and replayed the verifier in an isolated directory with all 45 checks passing. The recorded exact five-input-path-key bijection makes every replay output byte equal to the frozen original.
notes: The character is (r,s,t,u,v,w,(rstuvw)^-1), with C=<u,v,w,(rstuvw)^-1>. The exact field condition k0=k1(r) makes r-1 nonzero in every remaining proper-extension case and makes its m Frobenius conjugates distinct. The actual X1 principal projection and section identify H1 with the six original coordinates X2,...,X7. The boundary quotient has an explicit five-dimensional kernel, inclusion, coefficient section, basis and inverse. Source 0 acts as r times identity on that kernel. Boundary characters at sources 0,2,7 are 1,rt,t^-1. The two possible minimal invariant-subspace types and all three unordered cross-factor comparisons are proved through these actual maps. The invariant-kernel argument plus F24 gives summed restriction injectivity; F26 then proves finite affine equality while preserving the scalar character and field condition. General product-one characters without this field-generation property, full marginal equality and original K+=D+ remain unresolved.
